regressionGuard.covers: Unreviewed or substituted tasks executing a tier, incomplete results or stale snapshots passing local completion, and edits racing the final terminal decision.
regressionGuard.whatItChecks: Adversarial activation/run/completion cases deny wrong-task plans, stale or unpinned decisions, tier drift, missing step reports, skipped repairs and catalog mismatches, and intervening writers; accepted runs retain real raw statuses and exactly one authorized tier. Add focused writer-lock integration assertions alongside existing writer-lock tests.

validation.doNotEscalate: Run only this authorized tier under a newly approved bootstrap via the prior checked route until v4 cutover is proven. Focused tests are diagnostics, not substitutes; do not treat a blocked or incomplete run as a pass.
validation.why: Authorization, validation dispatch, evidence integrity, and writer coordination are security and concurrency boundaries; the registered heavy tier covers their existing integration surface.
